seo.title: Control Station — Central control of your API platform
seo.description: The Meecrogate Control Station: one interface to configure, monitor and administer the gateway, identity, orchestration and processes.

hero.title: The central Control Station
hero.description: Run, configure and monitor your entire Meecrogate platform from a single, intuitive graphical interface.

features.title: Management features
features.subtitle: A complete toolset to administer your API ecosystem

catalog.title: API catalogue
catalog.description: Bring all your APIs together and document them in a single, searchable catalogue.

monitoring.title: Real-time monitoring
monitoring.description: Watch the performance and health of your APIs on live dashboards.

access.title: Access management
access.description: Control precisely who can reach which API, with an advanced role system.

security.title: Security policies
security.description: Define consistent security rules and apply them across all your APIs.

templates.title: JSON templates for your components
templates.subtitle: Generate the JSON configuration for each Meecrogate component automatically, from ready-made templates you can adapt.

apiGateway.title: API Gateway
apiGateway.description: Generate JSON configurations to expose, secure and monitor your APIs.

identityServer.title: Identity Server
identityServer.description: Create configurations for OAuth2 and OIDC authentication and token management.

orchestrator.title: Orchestrator
orchestrator.description: Configure orchestration workflows to chain your services intelligently.

processExecutor.title: Process Executor
processExecutor.description: Write JSON configurations to automate your business processes.

cta.title: Ready to manage your APIs from one place?
cta.description: See how the Control Station can reshape your API governance, with a personalised demonstration.
